He has been dismissive, argumentative and overly opinionated on all occasions. Since joining the practice over a year ago, I have attended three appointments all with Dr Brown, as a last resort.

During each visit, Hereward stated that he was “investigating the root cause” of my symptoms. However, his approach often involved asking highly specific and sometimes irrelevant questions. When provided detailed answers, he would frequently dismiss them and continue probing until he found a question that could not be answered precisely - for example, demanding the exact time, to the minute, that a symptom occurred several weeks prior.

He then tended to challenge or debate responses rather than address the symptoms directly. Ultimately, he dismissed concerns altogether, stating that nothing appeared to be wrong and advising to “leave it be for some time.”

Following each of these consultations, I sought private medical advice. In all three instances, the private doctor/ consultant identified genuine health issues that required prompt treatment or medication, which resolved the problems. I was advised that, had these been left untreated, they could have become more serious.

Family members have had similar experiences with Hereward and some have reported that he made inappropriate comments during their consultations. Other reviews appear to reflect these same concerns.

I appreciate that Hereward Brown is, ultimately, running a business and dismissing patients certainly helps with the accounts; respectfully, there’s far more ethical ways to earn money. Those accreditations and letters after your name don’t mean much when you’re literally playing with lives and can’t diagnose basic matters.

His manner and approach raise significant concerns about patient care and professionalism. I believe patients deserve to be treated respectfully, taken seriously and given appropriate clinical attention; these concerns will be raised with the CQC, GMC and regulatory bodies.",null,[0,233]]]],[],[null,null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/reviews/data=!4m8!14m7!1m6!2m5!1sCi9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21NeVJtOWFjV1IzZFU1dmIyaG9VbHB0TFdVeGIzYxAB!2m1!1s0x0:0xf82e644b08f4d944!3m1!1s2@1:CAIQACodChtycF9oOmMyRm9acWR3dU5vb2hoUlptLWUxb3c%7C%7C?hl=en"],["https://www.google.com/local/content/rap/report?postId=Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT21NeVJtOWFjV1IzZFU1dmIyaG9VbHB0TFdVeGIzYxAB&t=1&&wv=1&d=286732320",null,null,"0ahUKEwjsk_zji7GTAxWYMWMBHTqGISQQoykIBCgB"],null,[null,[[1,1]]]],"0ahUKEwjsk_zji7GTAxWYMWMBHTqGISQQ0pMFCAIoAA"],null,"CAESY0NBRVFBUnBFUTJwRlNVRlNTWEJEWjI5QlVEZGZURUZoZEZoZlgxOWZSV2hFVkZCc1dFTlVNRGRWUmxSRlYyUjRVVUZCUVVGQlIyZHVPVEpVUVVOYVkxWkpVREJKV1VGRFNVRQ=="],[["Ci9DQUlRQUNvZENodHljRjlvT2xNNFkzWlBjRzF1WjJ0UExWRlVOazVYUTFGemVsRRAB",["0x0:0xf82e644b08f4d944",null,1760999778891206,1760999778891206,[null,null,["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/111429674908909963270/reviews?hl=en"],null,null,["3_little royaltys","https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/a-/ALV-UjWP4BncRuxwsFcyDb2dv7UaijdCaUTapsxH22zlzEhzuDdHhZA=s120-c-rp-mo-br100",["https://www.google.com/maps/contrib/111429674908909963270?hl=en"],"111429674908909963270",null,1,0,null,[0,2,1],0,["1 review",null,null,null,null,[null,"0ahUKEwjsk_zji7GTAxWYMWMBHTqGISQQ7LoGCAYoAA"]]]],null,"5 months ago",null,null,null,null,null,null,["Google","https://www.gstatic.com/images/branding/product/1x/googleg_48dp.png",null,null,5],null,1],[[1],null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,null,["en"],[["Went to get a blood drawn.
